requests: Ok je kan meer agents gebruiken indien nodig. wat gaan we allemaal in beta 18 doen ?
ok zorg dat je voor heel de nacht werk blijft houden maak desnoods de release groter en pak extra punten uit het plan op

scope: Beta18 + HA0.4.0b10: refreshed bilingual UI with plain-language help and one place for rooms (HA editor, E32 read-only with override), flow learner and warm-up planner (advice only), DHW episodes and burner cycles, typed optional energy inputs, split heating telemetry, web password change, OTA rollback with boot confirmation, supervisor network/Bluetooth/update checks, PSRAM-safe static atomics, bounded JSON, fuzz and soak tests in CI; HA entity cleanup, per-room devices, heating advice and heating problem sensors, reauth and Repairs. Shadow mode only; no boiler output; boiler settings writes disabled.
